component.name: ModemDeck
component.summary: WWAN and mobile broadband manager for Linux

description.p: ModemDeck is a Linux desktop application for inspecting and managing cellular modems through ModemManager and NetworkManager. It is written in Rust and uses Slint for its interface.

Available tools include signal and cell telemetry, supported-band controls with confirmation and rollback, APN and SIM management, traffic history, diagnostics, and optional desktop indicators. Availability depends on the modem, firmware, desktop session, and system services.
First stable ModemDeck 2 release after validation of the Rust and Slint migration.
Previous Linux release candidate published before the Rust and Slint migration.
